title: Learning Under Forgetting: Statistical Support-Selective Retention in Stochastic Training Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2609.38768v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prior work has shown that neural networks exhibit implicit biases toward low-complexity structure (e.g., spectral bias), memorization dynamics, and compression-like effects during training, but a unified dynamical account of selective retention remains incomplete. We propose Repeated Reinforcement with Persistent Forgetting (RPF) dynamics, a minimal framework in which repeated exposure reinforces patterns and structures that recur in the data, while persistent forgetting attenuates learned information. This view treats forgetting not merely as a failure mode, but as a selection mechanism. We build the theory in three successive layers. First, in an independent-feature model, we derive an exposure-selective survival law and a support-dependent retention boundary characterizing which patterns persist under forgetting. translated_title: 遗忘下的学习：随机训练动力学中的统计支持选择性保留
translated_abstract: 先前的研究表明，神经网络在训练过程中表现出对低复杂性结构的隐式偏好（如谱偏差）、记忆动力学以及类压缩效应，但对于选择性保留的统一动力学解释仍不完整。我们提出了带持久遗忘的重复强化动力学，这是一个极简框架：重复暴露会强化数据中反复出现的模式和结构，而持久遗忘会衰减已学习的信息。这一观点将遗忘不仅仅视为一种失败模式，而是视为一种选择机制。我们在三个递进的层次上构建该理论。首先，在独立特征模型中，我们推导出暴露选择性生存定律和支持依赖的保留边界，用以刻画哪些模式能在遗忘下持续存在。其次，在共享参数模型中，我们证明了遗忘会对协方差模态产生谱滤波效应，从而保留……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出带持久遗忘的重复强化（RPF）动力学框架，将遗忘从失败模式重新定义为一种选择机制，并通过递进的理论层次推导出暴露选择性生存定律和支持依赖的保留边界，揭示哪些数据模式能在随机训练的遗忘过程中存活。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Repeated Reinforcement with Persistent Forgetting (RPF) dynamics, reframing forgetting as a selection mechanism rather than a failure mode, and derives an exposure-selective survival law and a support-dependent retention boundary characterizing which patterns persist under forgetting during stochastic training.
